launch_template: am start -W -n io.github.hgamey.refbench/android.app.NativeActivity --es scene {scene} --es run_id {run_id} --es frames {frames} --es intensity {intensity} --es knob.loadop {loadop} [--es knob.postfx {postfx} --es postfx.shader {postfx_shader}]

run_id.note: echoed verbatim into output json for evidence chain

semantics.sr_pipeline: 低分辨率场景 pass 的 ALU loop = intensity*64 iterations

knob.loadop.route: MOBILE_GPU_OPT_ROUTES.md A-2 LoadOp/StoreOp DONT_CARE vs LOAD

knob.postfx.note: off = present blit 直接采样低分辨率 RT (驱动双线性放大), 作 A 臂对照; on = 在管线尾部插入外部 compute 算子, 低分辨率 RT -> 送显分辨率 RT

postfx.shader.note: 设备侧 candidate.spv 绝对路径。binding 0 = readonly 低分辨率图, binding 1 = writeonly 送显分辨率图, 工作组 16x16, 与 game_opt_loop 赛道契约一致
postfx.shader.failure: knob.postfx=on 时装载失败 (文件缺失 / 非 SPIR-V / 建管线失败 / 未给路径) 一律退出码 2 且 clean_exit=false。**绝不静默退回 off** —— 那会让 A/B 两臂变成 A 和 A, 而上层还以为在对照算子

exit_codes.0: clean: all frames submitted, json written
exit_codes.2: aborted: window lost or vulkan error, json may still be written with clean_exit=false

started_marker.written: right before entering the render loop; content = '<scene> <run_id>'
started_marker.note: harness polls this file for run-start; logcat is deliberately NOT part of the contract (observed to go completely silent on the bench device)

trace_comm_note: Adreno Vulkan driver submits kgsl cmdbatches from its own in-process threads (Thread-N), not the caller. refbench renames them via /proc/self/task/<tid>/comm so parse_trace.py --comm RefbenchDrv is stable.

sr_pipeline.note: 游戏以 1280x720 渲染 -> 管线尾部 compute 算子重构到 1920x1080 -> 呈现。算子与场景 pass 抢同一份带宽与功耗预算, 因此这里量到的 fps_p95 与整机瓦数才是算子在真实渲染上下文里的代价
